title: Communication Sciences and Disorders, Minor (College of Health and Human Development)
notes: 18cr exact bulletin match, computed 21cr against CMPSC after a real hidden-prereq addition. Prescribed Courses (6cr): CSD 146 (Introduction to Communication Sciences and Disorders) + CSD 269 (Deaf Culture), both prereq-free and both already independently required by the paired Communication Sciences and Disorders major (CSD) -- a no-op there. Additional Courses (3cr, select one of CSD 100/111/230/240/300/311/331) -- filled with CSD 111 (Preventing Hearing Loss), the only option NOT already required by the CSD major's own flowchart, keeping this credit genuinely new. Supporting Courses, Developmental and Biological Aspects sub-pool (3cr, select one) -- filled with HDFS 249N (Adult Development and Aging, prereq-free), also not already required by the CSD major. Supporting Courses, Interdisciplinary Connections sub-pool (6cr, select two) -- filled with CSD 451 (An Introduction to Augmentative and Alternative Communication) and CSD 462 (Clinical Bases of Language Disorders); both of their real prereq_groups require only CSD 300 (Child Language Development), which itself needs only the already-prescribed CSD 146 -- an intentionally efficient real chain where one hidden-prereq course (CSD 300) unlocks both electives at once. First draft instead picked HDFS 428, whose real Enforced Prerequisite (confirmed on the live bulletin course-description page, not just the flattened catalog groups) is '(HDFS 229 or PSYCH 212) and HDFS 312W' -- a genuinely deeper chain than the scraped catalog's two AND'd groups suggested (HDFS 312W itself needs EDPSY 101 or STAT 200), so it was dropped in favor of the CSD 300-anchored pair above once the live build surfaced a real 'could not schedule HDFS 428' warning. CSD 300/451/462 are all already independently required by the CSD major's own flowchart, so this Interdisciplinary pick is a near-total no-op there, while CSD 111 + HDFS 249N (6cr) stay genuinely new -- matching the bulletin's own stated 'at least six credits of the minor must be unique from the prescribed courses required by a student's major(s)' rule. The CSD 300 hidden-prereq item was encoded as an explicit requirement inside this minor's own file (same approach as BMEMIN/MARSCIMIN), so plan_progress reports the same 21.0cr minor:CSDMIN bucket total against both CMPSC and the paired CSD major. Verified against CMPSC (this catalog's standard baseline, grad_years=8) and against the paired CSD major -- 0 warnings, goal met in both pairings after the fix.
